base_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: attached Hearthbrew animation sprite atlas. Redraw ALL TWELVE frames, preserving precisely the existing 4-column x 3-row grid, frame order, position, orientation, hand scale, finger poses, prop contacts and transparent canvas. Output 2048 x 864 pixels, each cell 512 x 288. Replace every green baggy sleeve and cuff completely with a slim natural BARE FOREARM in the same warm tan skin as its hand; no fabric anywhere, no puffy forms. Simplify hands to friendly clean hand-painted cartoon anatomy: smooth warm skin, broad gentle shading, retain fingers and thumbs and only minimal finger separation lines. Remove skin mottling, freckles, veins, wrinkles, cuticle/knuckle detail and realistic skin texture. Keep the jars exactly where present, with same silhouettes. Warm watercolor game illustration with fine soft brown outlines. Match every pose individually, no pose copies. Clean genuine transparent background, no colored fringe, no stray flecks, no grid or text. Preserve connected forearm and hand and original frame exits. Do not add objects.
notes: Each original atlas is the edit target. First four pour pages, pour-05 and stir-01 also used the selected pour-01 redraw as a style reference. Final pour-06 uses only its original target and forbids props. Remaining stirring pages use only their original targets and explicitly preserve the wooden utensil. Generated export dimensions are normalized offline to 2048x864; playback keeps the existing native grid.
